entries.en: The chemist replaced the damaged ISE before repeating the fluoride measurement.
entries.zh: 化学工作者在重新测量氟离子前，更换了损坏的离子选择性电极。

entries.en: GPC revealed a second polymer fraction that the earlier test had missed.
entries.zh: 凝胶渗透色谱法揭示了先前测试遗漏的第二种聚合物组分。

entries.en: The operator checked the job log in MVS after the overnight batch failed.
entries.zh: 夜间批处理失败后，操作员在MVS操作系统中查看了作业日志。

entries.en: The museum curator placed an SLT module beside the older transistor assembly.
entries.zh: 博物馆馆员把一个固态逻辑技术模块放在更早的晶体管组件旁边。

entries.en: The student traced the transfer of the acyl group from ACP to the enzyme.
entries.zh: 学生追踪了酰基从酰基载体蛋白转移到酶的过程。

entries.en: The engineering team used the ASC to process the seismic survey data overnight.
entries.zh: 工程团队用先进科学计算机连夜处理了地震勘探数据。

entries.en: A fresh drop formed at the DME just as the recorder began the next scan.
entries.zh: 记录仪开始下一次扫描时，滴汞电极处恰好形成了一个新汞滴。

entries.en: The project manager postponed the FCA after the team found discrepancies in the test records.
entries.zh: 团队发现测试记录存在不一致之处后，项目经理推迟了功能配置审查。

entries.en: The engineer found that the LFS was passing the request to the wrong physical file system.
entries.zh: 工程师发现，逻辑文件系统把请求传给了错误的物理文件系统。

entries.en: She disputed the extra 20 dlr on the New York dealer's invoice.
entries.zh: 她对纽约经销商发票上多出的20美元提出了异议。

entries.en: The researchers measured TNF in the stored serum samples after the trial ended.
entries.zh: 试验结束后，研究人员测定了保存的血清样本中的肿瘤坏死因子。

entries.en: The sample label was damaged, so the laboratory could not link the CCK result to a participant.
entries.zh: 样品标签受损，因此实验室无法把缩胆囊素检测结果对应到某位参与者。

entries.en: The mill rejected the yarn because its measured linear density exceeded 30 tex.
entries.zh: 纺织厂因纱线的实测线密度超过30特克斯而拒收了它。

entries.en: The laboratory detected NG in residue taken from the old storage vessel.
entries.zh: 实验室在取自旧储存容器的残留物中检出了硝化甘油。

entries.en: We had played together online for years before we finally met in RL.
entries.zh: 我们一起在网上玩了好多年，后来才终于在现实生活中见了面。

entries.en: The recorded noise level fell by 6 dB after we fitted the new cover.
entries.zh: 装上新盖罩后，记录到的噪声级下降了6分贝。

entries.en: The pathologist noted that the tumour had reached the pia.
entries.zh: 病理学家注意到，肿瘤已经累及软脑膜。

entries.en: The warehouse manager checked the stock figures in the MIS before authorising another order.
entries.zh: 仓库经理在批准另一笔订单前，先查看了管理信息系统中的库存数字。

entries.en: The call centre used ANI to display the incoming caller's number.
entries.zh: 呼叫中心通过自动号码识别显示来电者的号码。

entries.en: The chemist recovered Ru from the used catalyst before analysing the other metals.
entries.zh: 化学工作者先从用过的催化剂中回收钌，再分析其他金属。

entries.en: The laboratory separated Lu from the other rare-earth elements in the mineral sample.
entries.zh: 实验室把矿物样品中的镥与其他稀土元素分离开来。

entries.en: The team had too little Bk to complete the planned experiment.
entries.zh: 团队拥有的锫太少，无法完成原定实验。

entries.en: After the spill, the technician had only 2 dL of the solution left.
entries.zh: 洒漏发生后，技术员只剩下2分升溶液。
